APPENDIX 11
BEN TORAH/BAS YISRAEL
FAQ: Is it so bad to be a woman that men thank 
Hashem that “You did not create me a woman”? And 
were men NOT created “according to Your will”?
FAQ: Women are also “committed to putting Torah 
into practice,” so how come they don’t put on tallis and 
tefillin?
FAQ: The general custom is that women do not say
. But why? Why the differences in

(and 
practices) between men and women?
I think everyone understands that this is not the place for a full discussion on this topic. Entire books have been written on this topic, 
Introduction
whereas this is simply an appendix to a siddur! More importantly, a lot depends on your personal experience and your family background. Of all the FAQs here, it is this one that is most likely to be understood differently by different people — just as things look different to two people, one of whom is wearing green-tinted glasses and the other yellow-tinted glasses!In addition, a lot depends on what you’ve already heard about this topic. Assuming you’ve had a good, standard yeshiva/Bais Yaakov education, you’ll have heard all the many varied and different explanations taught to boys and girls. If they resonated with you and you were satisfied with the answers, then great! You don’t need me. And if it all still bothers you, then one paragraph (even written by me!) may not help!“Rabbi Feigenbaum, are you trying to just duck and avoid this? Is this going to be another one of those classic, ’Oh, it’s very deep and we’re not worthy of understanding … ’ non-answer answers? Are you going to hide behind a lot of words in the hope that we don’t catch on that you have no answer? That is not why I bought this siddur!”
